display_information.name: Pollito
display_information.description: Quick polls in Slack with automatic closing, anonymous voting, and zero fees
display_information.long_description:
Pollito helps teams make fast decisions in Slack without messy threads or eternal discussions.

Key features:
• Automatic closing: Set a vote target (like 75% of the channel) or a time limit. The poll closes and posts the results the moment enough people vote.
• Anonymous voting: Teammates can vote honestly without pressure. Nobody can see who picked what, not even channel admins.
• Private reminders: Ping only teammates who have not voted yet, without tagging the entire channel.
• In-channel results: See live vote counts and progress bars directly inside the message.
• 100% free: Unlimited polls, votes, and team members with zero fees.

slash_commands.description: Create a quick team poll with automatic closing
